panels.title: CPU Usage by Mode (%)
panels.description: CPU breakdown: user (app work), system (kernel), iowait (disk bottleneck), steal (VM), irq, softirq

panels.title: Load Average Trend (1m / 5m / 15m)
panels.description: Load > CPU cores = overloaded. Load 1m > 15m = load increasing

panels.title: CPU I/O Wait % (Disk Bottleneck Indicator)
panels.description: High iowait = CPU stalled waiting for disk I/O

panels.title: Context Switches & Interrupts /s
panels.description: Very high context switches = many threads competing for CPU

panels.title: CPU Steal & Throttle (VM/Cloud health)
panels.description: Steal % > 5% = noisy neighbour in VM environment

panels.title: Memory Breakdown Over Time
panels.description: Memory distribution — Buffers+Cached can be reclaimed. True free = Available

panels.title: Swap Usage
panels.description: Swap usage — any swap = system is memory-constrained

panels.title: Page Faults & Memory Pressure
panels.description: Major page faults = process needed memory from disk (slow path)

panels.title: Memory Pages In/Out /s
panels.description: High pages-out while memory is full = active swapping

panels.title: Disk I/O Throughput (bytes/s)
panels.description: Read/write throughput per disk device

panels.title: Disk IOPS (operations/s)
panels.description: I/O operations per second — high IOPS with high latency = saturation

panels.title: Filesystem Usage % per Mount
panels.description: Disk space usage across all mounted filesystems

panels.title: Disk I/O Latency (avg ms per op)
panels.description: Average latency per I/O operation — above 20ms for HDD or 5ms for SSD is concerning

panels.title: Disk Queue Depth (I/Os in flight)
panels.description: Concurrent I/Os — sustained > 1 per device = I/O saturation

panels.title: Network Throughput (bytes/s)
panels.description: Network receive/transmit throughput excluding loopback

panels.title: Network Packets /s
panels.description: Packets per second — high packets with low bytes = many small transactions

panels.title: Network Errors & Drops /s
panels.description: Any persistent errors/drops indicate NIC or cable/driver issue

panels.title: TCP Connection States
panels.description: High TIME_WAIT = many short-lived connections (HTTP). High allocated = connection pressure

panels.title: Open File Descriptors
panels.description: Approaching max FDs causes EMFILE errors — tune fs.file-max if needed

panels.title: Running & Blocked Processes
panels.description: Blocked processes = waiting for disk/network I/O. High blocked = I/O bottleneck

panels.title: Network Sockets (TCP + UDP)
panels.description: Socket resource utilisation

panels.title: System Log (syslog)
panels.description: System-level log stream — kernel messages, service starts/stops, OOM killer events

panels.title: Application ERROR Logs
panels.description: All application error logs across all Frappe components

panels.title: Bench / Gunicorn Log
panels.description: bench.log — Gunicorn worker output, HTTP access, startup messages

panels.title: Syslog Rate (lines/min)
panels.description: Syslog volume — spike = system event (OOM, service restart, etc.)

panels.title: All Frappe Log Rate by Source (lines/min)
panels.description: Log volume per source type
